reference.pathophysiology: Indigestible particles frustrate alveolar macrophages whose oxidants and fibrogenic cytokines (TGF beta) scar surrounding interstitium in dust specific distributions. Long thin asbestos fibres reach pleura driving mesothelial carcinogenesis, while organic antigens instead provoke granulomatous immune alveolitis that fibroses only with continued exposure.
